subject: PoC: deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acmecorp.com>, Carlos Gutierrez <carlos.gutierrez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PoC: deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Acme Corp

Hi Dana / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment on the PoC approach and what success looks like.

Summary from call:
- Primary use case: real-time customer support summarization + entity extraction for triage.
- Expected baseline traffic for PoC: ~50 concurrent active sessions, ~3k tokens/min average.
- Key constraints: P95 latency target <200ms for short responses (<=256 tokens), data residency for EU customers (may affect final deployment), and SSO/SCIM required for internal users.

Deployment mode options we discussed:
1) Hosted API (fastest to integrate) — good for quick validation and quality checks; no dedicated capacity guarantees.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) — predictable throughput and isolation; preferred for sustained traffic at scale.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — required only if regulated data or strict network controls are mandated.

Proposed PoC plan (high-level):
- 4-week PoC starting as soon as both sides sign off.
- Week 0-1: integration + smoke tests on Hosted API; ingest sample prompts/data; baseline quality checks.
- Week 2-3: move to Dedicated pool (if agreed) to validate sustained throughput, autoscaling, and cost.
- Week 4: finalize metrics, run eval prompts, and review handoff + next steps.

Success criteria (proposed) — please confirm or edit:
- Latency: P95 <200ms for <=256-token responses (hosted baseline, dedicated for scale).
- Throughput: sustained 50 concurrent sessions (3k tokens/min) without >5% error rate.
- Cost: target token cost < $0.0009 per token for inference (TBD).
- Quality: F1 > 0.78 on entity extraction test set (we'll run your sample prompts).
- Security: SSO + audit logs available for PoC; if Private required, list mandatory controls.

Action items / asks from Acme:
1) Confirm primary deployment mode preference (Hosted to start, Dedicated for scale, or Private required).
2) Share sample prompts and a small representative data set (anonymized) — prefer CSV.
3) Confirm stakeholders to invite to kickoff (VP Eng, CISO, SRE lead).
4) Accept the PoC timeline (target start week of Jun 22).

I attached a short PoC plan (redwood-poc-plan-acme-20260610.pdf) and a sample prompts template.

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min alignment call if that's easier.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: PoC: deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Acme Corp

Thanks Ben — very helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- We like the suggested staged approach (Hosted -> Dedicated) because we want fast integration to validate quality but need dedicated capacity for predictable SLA during peak hours.
- Data residency: most of our traffic is US, but we have EU customers for whom we will require EU region support (this is probably later but want it noted).
- Security: CISO will want to validate audit logs + KMS integrations if we move to Dedicated/Private.

Stakeholders: 
- Carlos Gutierrez (VP Engineering) — primary technical stakeholder.
- Priya Sharma (CISO) — security/compliance owner (I will loop her into the next email).
- Kevin Moore (SRE lead) — will run load tests.

For the PoC data set, we've prepared a small anonymized CSV with 200 sample transcripts; attaching now (acme_sample_prompts.csv). We'll need your data-handling checklist for the PoC.

Timeline: week of Jun 22 works for us for kickoff. Would like a short internal pre-kickoff with our SRE + security folks on Jun 18 if that's possible.

Dana
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
Dana.Lee@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: PoC: deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Acme Corp

Great, Dana — thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample CSV.

A couple of follow-ups from our side and a slightly more detailed PoC checklist attached: redwood-poc-plan-acme-20260610.pdf (high level + technical runbook). Key notes: 
- We'll start integration on Hosted for the first week so you can get end-to-end traffic flowing quickly; this avoids early config work for Dedicated and lets us validate quality and parsing against your CSV.
- If we see sustained load above the target or you want predictable latency during load validation, we'll provision a Dedicated capacity pool in Week 2.
- Private/VPC: we'll only recommend this if your security team lists requirements that Hosted/Dedicated cannot satisfy (e.g., specific network egress controls, air-gap).

Proposed success criteria (short checklist to confirm):
- Integration: demo of end-to-end pipeline + sample responses by end of Week 1.
- Latency: P95 <200ms on Dedicated; will measure Hosted baseline and include charts in final report.
- Throughput: 50 concurrent sessions with <5% error during load tests.
- Quality: pass review of example outputs (Carlos + product team).
- Security: SSO + audit logs available; KMS keys for Dedicated if requested.

Operational asks from Acme:
1) A short list of IPs or CIDR ranges for testing if you want to lock down access during the Hosted phase.
2) SCIM user for your test SSO account (we can provide the SCIM connector details).
3) Confirmation of the pre-kickoff on Jun 18 with SRE + security (30 min).

If this looks good I'll send a proposed calendar invite for Jun 22 kickoff and loop in our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) to plan the load-test scripts with Kevin.

Best,
Ben

Subject: Re: PoC: deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Acme Corp

Hi all — quick tech notes from our end to make the kickoff smoother:

1) Dedicated sizing suggestion: to support 50 concurrent sessions (3k tokens/min) with headroom, we'd recommend a pool equivalent to 4x A40 GPUs (or similar) with autoscale to +2 for bursts. We'll provide a few performance profiles once we see token length distribution from your CSV.
2) Latency: on Dedicated the P95 target <200ms is achievable for 256-token responses with the tuned quantized profile; Hosted varies more depending on cross-tenant load.
3) Data/access: please upload anonymized prompts to the S3 link we'll provide. If you can't use S3, we can take the CSV via our secure upload.
4) Private/VPC: this will require at least 3 weeks of setup including network config, KMS handoff, and an audit review — so only recommend if mandatory.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the Week 1 smoke tests and the Week 2 load test scripts (will share before Jun 18).

Marissa
